N° 10Literary saga, essay and encyclopedia (French)2026

1884

A five-book saga in French, about 365,000 words long, on an invented regime set in the real Cameroon, from the 1884 treaty on the Wouri to a refounded social contract, opened by an illustrated essay on the African predicament and closed by an encyclopedia.

Visit the site ↗How to useEngineering record

Engineering recordFor technical reviewers

Wrote the novel and built its reading platform: a Python pipeline that typesets a 365,000-word manuscript into lazily loaded chapters, and an illustration system in which every pattern is generated in code.

The home page ships without any chapter text; opening a chapter fetches its HTML file by a stable address. Patterns such as ndop, kente and the Bamum script are drawn as SVG from parameters, and the 3D ring, railway and map fall back to flat drawings when WebGL is missing or motion is reduced.

Key engineering decisions

01

Load text on demand

A 1,100-page book cannot be one page on a phone; one file per chapter keeps the first load small and gives each chapter a permanent link.

02

Art as code

Generating patterns from parameters keeps the visual system consistent and weightless, and avoids licensing any imagery.

Notes for reviewers

Limits and next stepsFrench only for now; the same pipeline can emit an English edition and an EPUB once translated.
01

Problem statement

Studies of how African regimes retain power are written mainly for specialists, while novels on the subject are rare, short, or not read where they are set. Readers know the instruments from daily life (paid crowds, motions of support, purchased examinations) but rarely see the whole mechanism assembled, in their own language and with the history that produced it.

02

Contribution

The opening essay identifies seven causes of the African predicament (philosophy, history, organised stupidity, lack of creativity, black skin and white mask, failed politics, DNA), each with its own artwork. The saga follows a speechwriter who composes the voice of a president no one has seen for years, a captain who refuses to fire, a presenter who leads the regime’s marches by day and the resistance by night, and a midwife in Maroua, through an election, a massacre, imprisonment and a revolution in which the people fire no shot. The encyclopedia documents characters, institutions, places, rituals, objects and vocabulary, contains a three-dimensional railway timeline from 1884 to 2035 and a relief map, sets the regime’s fourteen rules against the people’s fourteen answers, and separates what is documented from what is invented.

03

Architecture

A static site with no client build step. Python scripts convert the Markdown manuscript into HTML under French typographic rules and store each chapter separately, to be loaded only when opened. Every pattern, symbol and figure is generated as SVG from code; Three.js r128 renders the ring of cloths, the railway and the map, with a fallback when 3D is unavailable.

04

Method and data

Chapters and sections have stable addresses. The reader offers adjustable type and a paper or night page; reduced-motion preferences are respected, and the layout is designed for telephones first.

05

Verification and limitations

No living person and no existing party appears in the novel. The regime is invented, while the dated prologues refer to documented events. The work is available in French only.
